title: Constrained Quasi-Periodic 22-Layer Stack with Half-Period Clamping
scientific_hypothesis: Score regression in rounds 3-4 resulted from optimization drifting into destructive interference regions; constraining thickness deviations to ±25 nm from nearest half-period multiples will maintain constructive interference while allowing fine-tuning.
design_principle: Quarter-wave baseline at 550 nm center wavelength with tight initialization perturbation (±5 nm) and hard optimization bounds that clamp any layer exceeding ±25 nm from its nearest λ/2n optical thickness multiple, preventing catastrophic phase mismatch.
proposed_topology: 22 finite layers: TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air incident medium
design_variables: layer thicknesses with half-period clamping constraint
manufacturing_considerations: half-period clamping maintains depositable thickness ranges
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack provides high-reflection baseline at design wavelength
Half-period optical thickness multiples maintain interference phase relationships
expected_advantages: Prevents optimization from wandering into destructive interference regions
Maintains physical intuition while allowing local refinement
Should recover round-2 performance level of 0.925
known_risks: May limit exploration of superior non-quarter-wave solutions
Clamping could create local minima if optimal solution requires larger deviations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degrees incidence. Initialize all TiO2 layers at 57 nm and all SiO2 layers at 96 nm (quarter-wave at 550 nm). Apply random perturbation of ±5 nm to initial thicknesses. During gradient optimization, enforce hard constraint: if any layer thickness deviates more than 25 nm from its nearest half-period multiple (TiO2: 57, 171, 285 nm; SiO2: 96, 288, 480 nm), clamp to nearest valid value and restart optimization step. Maximize weighted objective: 0.5 × mean_reflectance(450-650nm) + 0.5 × mean_transmittance(700-1000nm). Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Round 4 score dropped to 0.6747 from round 2 peak of 0.9251. Feedback directive specifies constrained quasi-periodic initialization with half-period clamping to prevent destructive interference. This route implements that exact mechanism with 22 layers matching prior topology but different initialization and constraint strategy.
